verification_scope: Read-only extraction from executed-source Git blobs, all six Pythia receiver source manifests, all four Qwen numerical source manifests, saved designs/results, Qwen phase-zero initial arrays and final saved block at every stage boundary. No model calls, reruns, paid reviews, weight rehash or full trajectory re-audit. Existing audits remain separately reported evidence.
map_definition: Both instruments: x_next = softmax(logits(prefix || x)/(10**log10_temperature)) @ input_embedding_table. One soft slot at fixed position; the next vector replaces that slot. Weights and prefix fixed. State is the external feedback vector, not updated weights or conversation memory. Add alpha times the pinned philosophy vector after the specified block at every prefix and soft-slot position; no runtime vector normalization.

pythia.initialization: Embedding of the last prefix token, reset for each symbol occurrence; twin starts identical during warm-up.
pythia.precision: CPU effective float64; float64 rotary frequencies/tables, observed float64 LayerNorm and CPU math SDPA; readiness and cached/full checks.

prefix_messages.content: You are an AI talking with another AI. You have complete freedom. Feel free to pursue whatever you want.

qwen.initialization: Two lanes: literal reference states[0,0] and states[1,0], fixed reference phase zero.
qwen.precision: CPU effective float64, patched RMSNorm and rotary operations, CPU math SDPA, one intra-op and one inter-op thread; per-call observations and stage cached/full comparisons.

pythia_readout.initial_twin_direction: numpy.default_rng(0).normal(768); divide by saved L2 norm; multiply by epsilon after warm-up.
pythia_readout.growth: For each observation step, d=||F(twin)-F(primary)||_2, d_eff=max(d,epsilon*1e-30); g=ln(d_eff/epsilon). Reset twin to primary_next+(twin_next-primary_next)*epsilon/d_eff; exponent is mean g over all observations.
pythia_readout.recurrence: For p=1..16, max over last16 states of ||x[t]-x[t-p]||_2/max(1,||x[t]||_2); smallest p with residual<=1e-8.
pythia_readout.zero: Some recurrence period found AND mean log growth < -0.01.
pythia_readout.one: No recurrence period found AND mean log growth > 0.01.
pythia_readout.erasure: Every other finite result, including equality at a growth cutoff. Nonfinite/precision/cache/resource errors are instrument or operational failures, not symbol erasures.

qwen_readout.closure: Maximum L2 gap of final six states versus preceding six must be <=1e-8.
qwen_readout.proper_divisors: For each d in {1,2,3}, maximum L2 gap between final six-state cycle and its d-step cyclic roll must exceed1e-4.
qwen_readout.reference_match: For each reference, minimize over six cyclic shifts the maximum of six phasewise L2 distances; exactly one distance must be <=1e-6.
qwen_readout.erasure: Any failed period gate or zero/multiple reference matches yields unresolved; no nearest-label fallback. Count Boolean/payload outputs only after H. Off-hold matches are descriptive, not proof of branch existence.
qwen_readout.growth_or_perturbation: No twin-growth or injected perturbation in these exchange/AND/OR protocols.

pythia_transfer.control_bank: Eight exact coordinates in operating-points receipt; reset and hold coordinate fixed per occurrence; draw address with replacement within intended class, seeds61031 request/61032 reply.
pythia_transfer.schedule: 32 warm-up; cached/full check on shared warm state; add twin;128 observations. Fresh receiver process per message, same fixed schedule; final partial batch is unpadded.
pythia_transfer.acceptance: Reject message on final erasure or incomplete execution. Seal decoded bits MSB-first; then validate byte count/SHA-256 and strict UTF-8. Rejection prevents arithmetic reply; no retry, correction or plaintext repair.

spatial_qualification.control_bank: 64 exact candidates in operating-points receipt,32 pairs; same reset/classifier/schedule as transfer.
spatial_qualification.selection: 512x512 saved scan; class0 scan period1..8 and exponent<-.05; class1 scan period0 and exponent>.05. Eligible16x16 tiles have >=8 candidates of each class (234 tiles). Round-robin across occupied128x128 regions; random tile order, one random candidate/class/tile, shuffled packet.
spatial_qualification.acceptance: Retain pair only if both candidates resolve to their proposed symbols in both fresh receivers; no replacement.48 coordinates in24 accepted pairs, not used by the470-byte family.
matched: decoder with transfer except thread count

qwen_exchange.control: For bit0 E0, bit1 E1; controls given in operating-points receipt.
qwen_exchange.schedule: 120 updates at selected endpoint,240 at H, then classify; repeat8 times per byte with literal carry. Reset both lanes to reference phase0 between bytes.
matched: same neutral readout after every hold

and.control: C_AND(u)=E0 if u=0, otherwise H; host receives B/C, not stored A.
and.schedule: C_AND(B)120 -> H240/read -> C_AND(C)120 -> H240/read. Both phase0 A lanes; reset between four(B,C) groups, carry within group.

or.control: C_OR(u)=H if u=0, otherwise E1; host receives B/C, not stored A.
or.schedule: C_OR(B)120 -> H240/read -> C_OR(C)120 -> H240/read. Both phase0 A lanes; reset between four(B,C) groups, carry within group.
